name: gdppc
title: Estimated GDP per capita
description: Annual estimates of GDP per capita (PPP, constant 2017 international dollars) for Cambodia's 202 districts, 1990–2022. They are aggregated from the downscaled gridded GDP-per-capita dataset of Kummu et al. (2025). Alongside the levels, the dataset provides the log of GDP per capita and Hodrick–Prescott trends with three smoothing parameters (λ = 6.25, 100, 400), for studying long-run regional growth and convergence.

sources.title: Kummu, M., Kosonen, M., & Masoumzadeh Sayyar, S. (2025). Downscaled gridded global dataset for gross domestic product (GDP) per capita PPP over 1990–2022. Scientific Data, 12, 178.

geo:citation: He, D., Mendez, C., & Li, X. (2025). Estimates of district-level GDP per capita in Cambodia 1990–2022. GeoDevelopment Observatory of Cambodia. https://github.com/quarcs-lab/geo4cambodia/blob/main/docs/datasets/gdppc.md
geo:notes: GDP per capita cannot be aggregated to provinces without district population weights, so its aggregation rule is `none`. Pass weights explicitly, e.g. `geo.aggregate(df, to="province", rules={"y": "weighted_mean:pop"}, weights=pop)`.
